title: Learning from Online Social Ties
main_or_robustness: main (Bayesian hierarchical model of user ratings as a function of social-tie counts, experience and their interactions, with latent instrumental variables)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: MCMC latent-utility rating model with continuous friend/follower/source counts interacted with experience and latent instrumental variables; no unit and time FE; no staggered binary treatment; not a DiD

eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Bayesian rating model on continuous social-tie counts with latent IVs.
design_notes: Code.m (MATLAB Gibbs sampler with rtrun_s.m); Newsfeed is a 0/1 covariate (716 of 87,946 rows), not a DiD treatment.
estimators_reported: Bayesian hierarchical latent-utility model with latent instrumental variables (MCMC)
data_files_note: 87,946 rating observations from 4,406 users; user IDs included.
data_provenance_note: Appears to be the estimation data; no statement of simulation or noise.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read where available; package_mismatch checked against title, authors and README. Regression inventory empty (0 lines); code read directly. OpenAlex record has no abstract and a wrong publication_year (batch year kept; published in Marketing Science 37(3), 2018); screened from package README and code.
